senses.gloss: m. (denom. of מֶלֶט, fr. לוט or לטט to wrap, cover; cmp. Syr. מלט P. Sm. 2136) frame or casing around the beam-rest in the wall (corresp. to מַלְבֵּן).—Pl. מַלְטֵטִין.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 67a:1">B. Kam. 67ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>צלעות</he>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 41:26">Ez. XLI, 26</cite>) <he>מ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מלטוסין</he>; Ms. H. <he>מלוטסין</he>, Ms. R. <he>מִלְטִין</he>), v. <cite ref="E00426"><he>הִימְלְטָא</he></cite>.
